points.quote: The default GenAI tool at BCU is Microsoft Copilot, for which you have free access via your BCU email address
points.gist: Microsoft Copilot is the default GenAI tool at BCU, with free access via a BCU email address.

points.quote: Do not use your BCU email address to sign up for third-party AI tools.
points.gist: Students must not use their BCU email address to sign up for third-party AI tools.

points.quote: Your assessment or exam brief will explain the AI usage level for that specific task (Option A – AI use allowed with conditions; Option B – AI not allowed; or Option C – AI required).
points.gist: The assessment or exam brief states the AI usage level: Option A allowed with conditions, Option B not allowed, Option C required.

points.quote: If you are not sure, please check with your module tutor.
points.gist: If unsure about the AI rules, check with the module tutor.

points.quote: BCU embraces a positive approach to GenAI and encourages students to use it in critical and responsible ways to support their learning
points.gist: BCU takes a positive approach to GenAI and encourages critical, responsible use to support learning.
